name: critic P27 a2r1 (fresh) - the score through recorded instruments: home village / overworld / battle live, loop overrun, layer phasing

steps.eval: (async () => { const { THEMES } = await import('/src/audio/score/index.js'); const man = await (await fetch('/vendor/samples/manifest.json')).json(); window.__crit = { overrun: Object.values(THEMES).filter(t => t.kind === 'loop').flatMap(t => t.events.filter(e => e.b >= t.introBeats + t.loopBeats - 1e-6).map(e => t.id + ':' + e.part + '@' + e.b)), victorySec: +THEMES.victory.lengthSec.toFixed(2), synthEvents: Object.values(THEMES).reduce((n, t) => n + t.events.filter(e => ['twinkle','pad','vox'].includes(e.voice)).length, 0), libs: Object.keys(man.libraries || {}) }; return window.__crit; })()

steps.note: held clarinet G4 mp: two unaligned velocity-layer takes are summed -> slow phase beating; measure the RMS swing of the sustain

steps.eval: (async () => { const b = await __DQ.renderAudio('note:clarinet:G4:mp:12:60', 14); const d = b.getChannelData(0), sr = b.sampleRate, h = Math.floor(sr * 0.1); const db = []; for (let i = Math.floor(sr * 1.5); i + h < Math.floor(sr * 11); i += h) { let s = 0; for (let j = 0; j < h; j++) s += d[i + j] * d[i + j]; db.push(10 * Math.log10(s / h + 1e-12)); } window.__crit.clarSwingDb = +(Math.max(...db) - Math.min(...db)).toFixed(1); return window.__crit.clarSwingDb; })()
